name: OLS
summary: UK nonprofit that sponsors open research communities, and individuals building one, among people it has already trained or worked with.

evidence.quote: a group of people working on open research or other OLS-adjacent domains for whom OLS handles infrastructure to help them receive grants

value.note: as an Incubation Fellow, if you have trained or worked with OLS
